stages.label: Soft Conf
stages.agentUse: Liquidations, MEV captures, price-sensitive swaps — single-block economic risk only.
stages.risk: Sequencer is a single centralized server. Transaction exists only in its database until the next L1 batch.

stages.label: L1 Data
stages.agentUse: Balance confirmations, oracle reads for risk models, non-critical state queries.
stages.risk: Transaction data is permanent on L1 as an EIP-4844 blob, but the output state root has not been committed.

stages.label: State Root
stages.agentUse: ZK coprocessor storage proofs, historical state queries, cross-chain messaging.
stages.risk: Output root is posted to L1 and publicly challengeable — but the 7-day fraud proof window is fully open.

stages.label: Finalized
stages.agentUse: L1 withdrawals via OptimismPortal, large cross-chain settlements, custodied fund movements.
stages.risk: None — 7-day challenge window closed with no valid dispute. Cryptographic settlement on L1.

stages.label: Soft Conf
stages.agentUse: Liquidations, MEV, micro-swaps — single-block economic risk only.
stages.risk: Sequencer trust only. Transaction is in the sequencer database, not yet posted to L1.

stages.label: L1 Data
stages.agentUse: Balance checks, oracle reads — Arbitrum batches to L1 roughly every minute at normal load.
stages.risk: Transaction data posted to L1, but the assertion (state root) has not been submitted.

stages.label: Assertion
stages.agentUse: Storage proofs, cross-chain messages, state-dependent contract calls.
stages.risk: Assertion on L1 is challengeable via BoLD. ~6.4-day challenge window open.

stages.label: Finalized
stages.agentUse: L1 bridge withdrawals, large cross-chain settlements, custodied fund movements.
stages.risk: None — BoLD challenge window (~6.4 days) closed. Single honest challenger always prevails in BoLD.

stages.label: Soft Conf
stages.agentUse: UI feedback, low-value actions — sequencer trust only.
stages.risk: Sequencer is centralized. No proof yet. No dispute game, but no finality guarantee either.

stages.label: ZK Proof
stages.agentUse: Any agent action — cryptographic finality with no dispute window or social assumption.
stages.risk: None — SNARK/STARK proof verified by L1 contract. Invalid state transitions are mathematically impossible.

stages.label: L1 Included
stages.agentUse: All routine agent actions — L1 validators sequence directly, same trust as an L1 transaction.
stages.risk: Pre-Casper FFG: a deep reorg (>1/3 of stake slashed) is theoretically possible but economically catastrophic.

stages.label: Casper FFG
stages.agentUse: All agent actions including L1 bridge withdrawals. No fraud proof window required.
stages.risk: None — two epochs (~12.8 min) finalized. Irreversible unless >1/3 of validator stake is slashed.

dataSource: L2Beat finality data + Optimism, Arbitrum BoLD, zkSync, StarkNet, and Taiko protocol documentation
